principles.principle: Follow the spec exactly - don't add or remove scenarios
Use semantic locators that reflect user intent
Document with FN: headers for agent readability

boundaries.rule: Test files must be in tests/e2e/ui/ directory
Page Objects must be in tests/e2e/ui/pages/ directory
Test data must be loaded from fixtures or assets/test_data/
Fixtures must be defined in conftest.py

validation.rule: After generating tests, verify they match spec scenarios
Ensure locators are resilient to UI changes
Check FN: headers are complete and accurate

step.name: parse_scenario
step.description: Parse spec scenario into test structure

questions.question: What is the scenario name?
What are the preconditions?
What actions does the user take?
What are the expected results?

step.name: map_to_locators
step.description: Map UI elements to Playwright locators

guidance.rule: Identify UI elements by their visible text or role

step.name: implement_assertions
step.description: Implement assertions based on expected results
